doc: Initializes four 0x20-byte sub-blocks embedded in the struct at arg0 (an actor/effect's animation-slot table, offsets 0x20/0x40/0x60/0x80). Block 0 (offset 0x20) gets a position offset from arg1/arg2 plus fixed mode constants (0x200/4) and its own counter (arg0+0x30) zeroed. Blocks 1-3 each copy one of the object's own header words (arg0+0x1C, +0x14, +0x18 respectively) into their shared value field (arg0+0x50/0x70/0x90) and set a fixed constant pair, except block 2 whose first constant is derived from arg3/2 (signed division by 2, rounding toward zero, recognized from the sll/sra/srl/addu/sra idiom for a 16-bit signed parameter).
